axes.correctness: Every value, condition, write and source pointer matches the code at the inspected revision; nothing is invented; gaps are disclosed.
axes.visual_design: Machines are cast by behaviour from the catalogue; one accent; calm tones; aligned main route; consistent spacing; both themes work.
axes.visual_clarity: A newcomer can name each structure from its shape and follow the item from input to output in under a minute without reading prose; no text walls.

scoring.baseline: velocitty/factorio.svg made by the previous factorio-md skill was scored 9 correctness, 5 visual design, 3 visual clarity by the owner. A new run must beat 5 and 3 without dropping correctness below 9.

evals.prompt: Make a beltline tour of evals/files/ringlog. Use the test's lines.
evals.expected_output: One beltline.svg. Station tier. RingLog.buf is a drum with 3 sectors and head/tail arms; the trace writes boot, load, ready, then tick forces flush(1) so boot leaves on a belt to a sink dock and tick lands in sector 0; final head=1 tail=1. write() and flush() are the only function machines. The end-state markup shows load, ready, tick in the drum.
expectations: node scripts/check.mjs beltline.svg prints 'svg check passed'
node scripts/check-sources.mjs beltline.svg evals/files/ringlog prints 'sources: 0 unresolved'
build output contains 'audit passed'
the SVG contains a machine with class m-drum
the SVG contains the values boot, load, ready and tick
the transcript shows capture.mjs was run and its PNGs were opened
the final summary includes a cast table

evals.prompt: how does the lru thing in evals/files/lru work? picture pls

expectations: the SVG contains a machine with class m-pigeonholes
the SVG does not contain the words heap or timestamp
the SVG shows b being evicted, not a
the final summary mentions that README.md does not match the code
svg check passed and sources: 0 unresolved
